Full-period: Downballot Aug 19, 2026: 12.5 vs Harris and 8.4 vs Biden across 110 specials since Jan 2025. MultiState (Oct 14, 2026): 2026 median 10.4 over 37 contested Jan-Apr specials, 10 over May-Oct (https://www.multistate.us/insider/2026/10/14/democrats-special-election-edge-still-points-to-a-big-year-democratic-wave). Brookings/DLCC (Apr 2026): 4.5 avg; 30 GOP-to-Dem legislative flips, none reverse. Includes all special types, not only state legislative. [Verification 2026-11-04] Confirmed: Downballot 12.5 vs Harris / 8.4 vs Biden over 110 specials (Aug 19, 2026); Daily Kos 13.3 for '2025-26 cycle' (no race count given, so labeling it 2025 is approximate); Newsweek 11 for 2026 specials ('nearly 13' including late-2025 races); MultiState medians 10.4 (37 races Jan-Apr) and 10 (six contested May-Oct).
